environment.description: AWS Lambda running in Step Functions workflow. PostgreSQL RDS instance with database user 'oauth_service' having full CRUD permissions (GRANT ALL ON oauth_grants, oauth_clients TO oauth_service). API Gateway with no additional request validation. The Lambda function's IAM role allows states:SendTaskSuccess and full network access to the RDS instance. No WAF or request filtering configured on the API Gateway stage.

config.db_permissions: GRANT ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO oauth_service
config.api_gateway: REST API with Lambda proxy integration, no request validators
config.network: Lambda in VPC with RDS access, no additional NACLs
